$description: Wave 3 (W3 Forms-Core, D-015) component tokens for Switch. Track-on reuses `color.role.neutral.solid` (same accent-scarcity reasoning as checkbox.json/radio.json — a settings panel commonly renders many switches, so the scarce brand accent stays off this control). Track-off uses `color.border.interactive` as a FILL (not just a border) so the thumb always has >=3:1 against whichever track state is showing: thumb (`color.text.onRoleSolid`, the same theme-flipping white/near-black pair Badge and Checkbox already use) measures 4.27:1 (light) / 3.72:1 (dark) against track-off, and 9.39:1 (light) / 7.94:1 (dark) against track-on — every pair clears the 3:1 non-text/UI-component minimum in both themes. Track boundary border reuses `color.border.interactive` again for the outer edge against `color.surface.raised` (3.96:1 / 3.54:1). The on/off state has a non-color cue by construction: the thumb's inline position (`inset-inline-start`) physically changes, independent of any color per BLUEPRINT §7 / braun-flat rule 4.
